Investors.the_entry_point_is_chronic_dis.translation: Isi mmalite bụ ọrịa na-adịgide — ESRD na dialysis, diabetes, na onye ọbụla nke ọrịa ya ga-elekọta kwa ụbọchị kama mgbe ụfọdụ.
